parsed_json.up: Select distinct compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, then LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return only compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
